text: The experience made me see the bigger picture. When I'm in a stressful situation now, I try to remember that I'm a tiny part of something much larger and that this moment is not everything. It sounds abstract but it really helps me not to take every setback so seriously, for example when my landlord terminated my lease.
Ich reagiere ruhiger auf Stress und kann mich schneller wieder fangen, wenn etwas schiefläuft.

I've always been someone who takes on too much and then collapses. During the experience I had a very clear vision of myself as a pack mule carrying everyone's bags, my mother's, my brother's, my boss's, my friends'. I could see that none of them had asked me to carry them, I just picked them up because I feel worthless if I'm not useful. That image has stayed with me. When a stressful situation comes up now, I often ask myself: whose bag is this? Is this mine to carry? It has helped me enormously with setting boundaries. When my brother got into debt again last spring, I didn't jump in to rescue him like I always did. I told him I love him but he needs to sort it out. I felt guilty, but I also felt free. At work I've started saying no to extra projects. I still get stressed, but it's more my own stress now, not everyone else's.
I've started doing breathwork and cold showers since the experience. When I feel stressed I do box breathing for a few minutes. Helps me a lot.

Ich gehe mit belastenden Ereignissen gelassener um, weil ich gelernt habe, dass ich nicht alles kontrollieren kann. Während der Erfahrung gab es einen Moment, in dem ich mich völlig ausgeliefert gefühlt habe und dachte, ich werde verrückt. Als ich dann aufgegeben habe, dagegen anzukämpfen, wurde es plötzlich ruhig und schön. Das hat mir sehr viel beigebracht. Wenn heute etwas Belastendes passiert, etwa als mein Sohn im Krankenhaus war, versuche ich, das anzunehmen und mich auf das zu konzentrieren, was ich tun kann.
Didn't change much. I handle stress the same way as before.

The biggest change for me is that I don't isolate myself anymore when things get hard. I used to go silent for days and not tell anyone what was going on. Now I reach out. When I got laid off, I called three friends that same evening and we went out for dinner. It made it so much easier to deal with. I think the experience showed me how much I'm loved, and that I don't have to deal with everything alone.

Leider eher negativ. Nach der Erfahrung, die sehr beängstigend war, war ich über Monate hinweg viel stressanfälliger als vorher. Kleinigkeiten, wie ein voller Bus oder ein lautes Geräusch, haben bei mir Herzrasen und Panik ausgelöst. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass mein Nervensystem überreizt ist. Ich habe dann mit einer Therapie begonnen, und es ist besser geworden, aber ich bin immer noch empfindlicher, wenn es stressig wird. Ich glaube, ich war damals einfach nicht in der richtigen Verfassung für so eine starke Erfahrung, und das hat Spuren hinterlassen.
I don't let stressful things get to me as much, I stay calmer and more focused.

The experience changed how I relate to difficulties in a fundamental way. During the trip there was a long phase where I felt I was dying, and after fighting it for what felt like hours, I let go, and I was met with this enormous peace and a sense that everything is exactly as it should be. That experience of surrender has become a reference point for me. When stressful events happen now, I remember that resisting makes it worse and that there's usually something on the other side. Last year my partner and I went through a miscarriage, and it was devastating. But I was able to be present with the grief instead of running from it, and I could support my partner. I also see things in a much bigger context now. I feel that life has seasons, and the hard ones are part of it. That perspective has helped me through job stress, a move, and my father's illness. I don't want to sound like I'm always calm, I'm not, but I recover faster and I don't feel like the world is ending every time something goes wrong.

Ich habe durch die Erfahrung erkannt, dass ich in stressigen Situationen immer versuche, es allen recht zu machen, und dabei mich selbst vergesse. Seitdem achte ich mehr darauf, was ich eigentlich brauche, und sage öfter, wenn mir etwas zu viel wird.
I'm more patient when things don't go to plan. I used to get frustrated very quickly, now I can wait it out.

The experience made me realise how much I live in my head, especially when I'm stressed. I overthink everything and imagine worst case scenarios. Since then, I've started practicing mindfulness and I try to come back to my body when I notice my thoughts spinning. I put my feet on the floor, feel my breath, name 5 things I can see. It's simple but it works for me most of the time, and I understand my stress patterns much better than before.
Probleme erscheinen mir nicht mehr so groß wie früher. Ich weiß, dass sich die meisten Dinge mit der Zeit von selbst lösen, und mache mir weniger Sorgen.

My life has been quite stressful in the last couple of years, I lost my job, my mother died, and I moved to a new city. Before the experience, I think I would have fallen apart, because I always tried to handle everything alone and pretend I was fine. The experience taught me two things. First, that it's okay to feel what I feel, and that sadness and fear are not enemies. I let myself cry when my mother died, a lot, and I didn't feel ashamed. Second, that I'm not alone. During the experience I felt deeply connected to my friends and family, and I realised that they want to be there for me. So when things got hard, I asked for help. My best friend came to stay with me for a week after the funeral. My sister and I talked on the phone every day. I joined a grief group in my new city. I'm still sad sometimes, of course, but I feel I've dealt with all of this in a much healthier way than I ever could have before. I'm proud of how I handled it, which I never would have said about myself before.
Stay calmer, think before I act

Ich bin insgesamt gelassener geworden und kann mit Stress besser umgehen. Ich habe gelernt, dass ich nicht sofort auf alles reagieren muss, sondern auch mal abwarten kann. Belastende Situationen nehme ich eher als Teil des Lebens an und versuche, das Beste daraus zu machen, statt mich darüber zu ärgern.

I have a better understanding of why I react the way I do when I'm stressed. I tend to get defensive and shut down, and I see now that it comes from feeling criticised as a kid. Knowing this makes it easier to catch myself.

The experience gave me a sense of perspective that I didn't have before. I used to worry about everything: money, my career, what people think of me, my health, climate change. During the experience, I felt that I'm part of something eternal and that my small worries, while real, are not the whole story. Now when something stressful happens, I can step back and see it from a distance. I remind myself that I've survived everything so far, and that most of what I worried about in the past never happened. This doesn't make problems disappear, but it makes them feel more manageable, and I have more energy to actually deal with them instead of just worrying.
Da hat sich nichts geändert, ich gehe mit Stress genauso um wie vorher.

I'm much better at communicating when I'm stressed. Before, I would snap at my partner and then not explain why. Now I tell her when I've had a bad day and what I need, which is usually just some quiet time. We fight a lot less because of this. I also feel more able to talk to my colleagues when there's a problem instead of stewing about it.
I stay calmer in stressful situations and I can think more clearly, for example during exams or job interviews.

Durch die Erfahrung habe ich gelernt, meine Stressreaktionen besser zu verstehen. Ich habe während der Erfahrung gesehen, wie mein Körper auf Angst reagiert: Mein Bauch zieht sich zusammen, meine Schultern gehen hoch, ich halte den Atem an. Das hatte ich vorher nie bemerkt. Jetzt erkenne ich diese Signale im Alltag früher und kann gegensteuern, indem ich bewusst atme, die Schultern fallen lasse und mich kurz zurückziehe. Ich habe außerdem verstanden, dass mein Stress oft mit dem Gefühl zusammenhängt, nicht gut genug zu sein, und dass dieses Gefühl aus meiner Kindheit stammt, als mein Vater sehr hohe Erwartungen an mich hatte. Mit diesem Wissen kann ich in belastenden Situationen freundlicher mit mir sein. Ich habe auch angefangen, regelmäßig zu meditieren, was mir sehr hilft. Insgesamt bin ich viel besser in der Lage, mit Stress umzugehen, auch wenn es immer noch Momente gibt, in denen ich in alte Muster falle.

I've become more accepting of the fact that bad things happen. When something stressful comes up, I don't fight it as much as I used to. I just let it be what it is and do what I can. That has taken a lot of pressure off.
Less stress overall. I'm not as tense, and I recover from stressful days faster than I used to.

Ich habe durch die Erfahrung gelernt, Dinge aus einer anderen Perspektive zu betrachten. Wenn heute etwas Stressiges passiert, frage ich mich, wie wichtig das in einem Jahr noch sein wird. Meistens ist die Antwort: gar nicht. Das hilft mir, ruhig zu bleiben. Ich bin auch weniger ängstlich, was die Zukunft angeht, weil ich darauf vertraue, dass sich die Dinge fügen. Das hat mir zum Beispiel bei meinem Jobwechsel geholfen, der mit viel Unsicherheit verbunden war.
I can handle stress better, I don't let it take over my life

I use some techniques that I learned in preparation for the experience, especially breathing and grounding. I also journal more and I've started going to a yoga class once a week. When I'm stressed now, I have a toolbox to go to, instead of just drinking a bottle of wine like I did before. I think the experience motivated me to look after myself more actively.
Ich kann belastende Ereignisse besser hinnehmen, auch wenn sie mir nicht gefallen. Ich habe gelernt, dass Widerstand oft mehr Leid erzeugt als die Situation selbst.

Since the experience I am much more aware of my own patterns when I'm stressed. During the trip, I saw how I always go into fight mode, how I try to control everything and everyone, and how exhausting this is for me and for the people around me. I also saw that underneath this is a deep fear of losing control, which I think comes from growing up with an alcoholic parent where everything was unpredictable. Since then, when I notice myself getting controlling, I try to stop and ask myself what I'm afraid of. Often I can then let go a bit. I've also been reading a lot about adult children of alcoholics, which has helped me make sense of myself.
Calmer. I don't stress over small things anymore, and I sleep even when there's a lot going on.

Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob die Erfahrung etwas verändert hat. Vielleicht sehe ich manche Dinge etwas entspannter, aber das kann auch am Alter liegen. Insgesamt würde ich sagen, ich gehe mit Stress ungefähr so um wie früher.

The experience helped me to handle stressful events by making me feel more connected to the people around me. I used to be very independent, almost to a fault, and I never asked for help. During the experience I felt a deep sense of love and belonging, especially with my family. I realised I had been keeping them at arm's length. Since then I talk to them much more openly. When my marriage ended last year, it was the most stressful time of my life, but I didn't go through it alone. My parents and my brothers were there for me, and I let them. I also found that I stayed calmer than I expected. I was sad and scared, but I didn't panic or fall into a depression like I did after my last breakup. I think having that sense of connection made all the difference, and I also learned to trust that I can get through difficult things. I've since helped a friend through a similar situation and I could really be there for her.
I'm more relaxed when things go wrong. I used to catastrophise but now I can usually see that it's not the end of the world.

Ich habe das Gefühl, dass ich stressige Situationen heute viel ruhiger angehe als früher. Ich war immer jemand, der schnell in Panik gerät, wenn etwas Unvorhergesehenes passiert. Seit der Erfahrung kann ich in solchen Momenten innehalten und mich fragen, was jetzt eigentlich zu tun ist. Das hat mir im Beruf schon oft geholfen, ich arbeite in der Pflege, und da gibt es viele stressige Situationen.

I see things more in perspective now. Problems at work feel less important compared to the big questions of life. That helps me not get too stressed out, though sometimes it also makes me care less about doing a good job.
Worse, I get anxious way more easily since then

Ich habe gelernt, dass ich meine Gefühle in belastenden Situationen nicht unterdrücken muss. Früher habe ich immer funktioniert und erst später zusammengebrochen. In der Erfahrung habe ich gemerkt, wie viel Kraft es mich kostet, immer stark zu sein. Ich habe auch verstanden, dass ich das so gelernt habe, weil meine Mutter krank war und ich mich um meine kleinen Geschwister kümmern musste. Heute erlaube ich mir, auch mal schwach zu sein, und das macht mich paradoxerweise stärker, weil ich nicht mehr so schnell erschöpft bin.

Ich habe nach der Erfahrung angefangen, Tagebuch zu schreiben und regelmäßig spazieren zu gehen. Wenn ich gestresst bin, schreibe ich meine Gedanken auf, das hilft mir, sie zu sortieren. Außerdem achte ich mehr auf meinen Schlaf.
I'm able to stay calm under pressure. At my job as a paramedic that's really important, and I think I've become better at not taking the stress home with me after a hard shift.
